SELECT round(coalesce(sum(l.line_total), 0)) AS ventas
FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL
  AND h.doc_date >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 days'
  AND h.doc_date <  date_trunc('week', now())
widgets.title: Ventas semana pasada (MXN)

widgets.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS entregas FROM (
  SELECT l.base_entry,
         min(CASE WHEN l.ship_date BETWEEN h.doc_date - interval '60 days' AND h.doc_date + interval '60 days'
                  THEN l.ship_date ELSE h.doc_date END) AS fecha
  FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
  JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
  WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.base_type = 15
  GROUP BY l.base_entry
) e
WHERE e.fecha >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 days'
  AND e.fecha <  date_trunc('week', now())
widgets.title: Entregas semana pasada

SELECT round(coalesce(sum(l.quantity), 0)) AS cajas
FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.unit_msr = 'CAJA'
  AND h.doc_date >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 days'
  AND h.doc_date <  date_trunc('week', now())
widgets.title: Cajas vendidas semana pasada

widgets.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', h.doc_date)::date AS semana,
         substring(coalesce(i.item_name, l.dscription) from '^[^0-9]{0,4}([0-9]+) ') AS calibre,
         l.line_total
  FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
  JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
  LEFT JOIN sap_hana_raw.oitm i ON i.item_code = l.item_code
  WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL
), top AS (
  SELECT calibre FROM v WHERE calibre IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(line_total) DESC LIMIT 7
)
SELECT to_char(v.semana, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
       CASE WHEN t.calibre IS NULL THEN 'Otros' ELSE 'Calibre ' || v.calibre END AS producto,
       round(sum(v.line_total)) AS importe
FROM v LEFT JOIN top t ON t.calibre = v.calibre
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
widgets.title: Ventas por calibre por semana (MXN)

widgets.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', h.doc_date)::date AS semana,
         substring(coalesce(i.item_name, l.dscription) from '^[^0-9]{0,4}([0-9]+) ') AS calibre,
         l.quantity, l.line_total
  FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
  JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
  LEFT JOIN sap_hana_raw.oitm i ON i.item_code = l.item_code
  WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.unit_msr = 'CAJA'
), top AS (
  SELECT calibre FROM v WHERE calibre IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(line_total) DESC LIMIT 7
)
SELECT to_char(v.semana, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
       CASE WHEN t.calibre IS NULL THEN 'Otros' ELSE 'Calibre ' || v.calibre END AS producto,
       round(sum(v.quantity)) AS cajas
FROM v LEFT JOIN top t ON t.calibre = v.calibre
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
widgets.title: Cajas por calibre por semana

widgets.sql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', e.fecha), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana, count(*) AS entregas
FROM (
  -- fecha de entrega: ship_date de la línea; si es incoherente (más de 60 días de la factura), la fecha de factura
  SELECT l.base_entry,
         min(CASE WHEN l.ship_date BETWEEN h.doc_date - interval '60 days' AND h.doc_date + interval '60 days'
                  THEN l.ship_date ELSE h.doc_date END) AS fecha
  FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
  JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
  WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.base_type = 15
  GROUP BY l.base_entry
) e
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
widgets.title: Entregas por semana

widgets.sql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', h.doc_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
       l.item_code AS codigo,
       coalesce(max(i.item_name), max(l.dscription)) AS producto,
       count(DISTINCT l.base_entry) FILTER (WHERE l.base_type = 15) AS entregas,
       round(sum(l.quantity)) AS cantidad,
       max(l.unit_msr) AS unidad,
       round(sum(l.line_total)) AS importe_mxn
FROM sap_hana_raw.inv1 l
JOIN sap_hana_raw.oinv h ON h.doc_entry = l.doc_entry
LEFT JOIN sap_hana_raw.oitm i ON i.item_code = l.item_code
WHERE h.canceled = 'N' AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL
  AND h.doc_date >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '28 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 DESC, importe_mxn DESC
widgets.title: Detalle por producto, últimas 4 semanas
